A great read!

It's weird how few question these labels on gaming industry. There are insane amounts of gamers, why are these "victims" drawing conclusions on all of us based on a small minority trolling them?

I really like his point #3. First I've heard somebody other than me say it.

A troll wants to get under your skin, so he looks for a hook. If he knows you're gay, you'll get gay jokes. If he knows you're fat, fat shaming. If he knows you dropped out of school, dumb jokes. If he knows you're female, any number of anti-woman remarks. Dude isn't necessarily anti- any of those things, he's just trying to piss you off and he's using all the ammo he can get his hands on.

So troll remarks aren't proof of anything at all in the wider society.
You mean to tell me not everything someone posts on the internet is 100% true? Get the fuck out.

Worse, the number of resumes for female developers available for AAA studios to hire is going down because of this fabricated perceived hostility they will face, and this is only going to make women less represented in games as time goes on, fewer strong female characters in games.

Thats feminism for you, telling women they are systemically oppressed and that men always harm women then expect them to feel empowered instead of hopeless.
God bless this guy, he's saying what all of us GGers have been saying, but did so more eloquently than I ever could.

Great summary of what the GamerGate people have been saying all along.

Particularly liked the equivalence of Jack Thompson and Anita Sarkeesian. I'd say two people cut from the same cloth, but Jack at least acknowledged the stifling effect on free speech that is occurring.

Also illustrates the horrible bias of the press. Not just the gaming press but all the press.

Possibly superfluous side note: The reddit admin "raldi" saw this article on another site and in his response he explicitly outed himself as pro-Anita and anti-GamerGate:

https://archive.is/IWpt8
This guy has to be a writer of some sort this was just too well written. The piece really hit me and I think I'll be remembering it for a while.

The problem is, that while he's right, he also shown people that SJW are winning right now - "yes, we're with you but we need to protect our identify because SJW can destroy us". That's the step of destroying not only free speech but free thinking as well. Which is fucking bad and scary. And as he pointed out - SJW won't listen to this article. They'll give it "troll/white-cis/opression stamp" and look forwards for their idols. We shouldn't try to convince SJWs they're wrong. They won't listen. They might grow up but it's not onto us. We need to show people OUTSIDE of this that we are not bad guys. People who play casually. People who doesn't play but hear'd that games are bad because some stupid article. Etc, etc. Those are the peoples who we can convince and then they - as mass - can choose to fight against SJW. Because SJW can't do shit to them. Not CEO's, big figures of industry we need, but normal people, like you and me(eeeh, goat!).

Man, I still have sympathy for all these devs and journalists that are afraid to speak out, and I hope this guy is encouraged to do an interview or AMA after this.

But it is getting incredibly irksome that we have devs and journos in our number sticking their fucking necks out for the rest of them, that we have so many regular people in our number who have come out of anonymity and pseudonymity to take a stand against these bullies, and 11 months on we're still happily swallowing the "you have a lot of support in the industry, but we're too scared to speak out" bollocks.

No.

Not any more. We have been smeared by the global media for almost a year. As a result, many in our number - devs and gamers alike - have had real life negative consequences for doing the right thing and speaking out.

Put your big boy/girl trousers on and add your voice to the tens, maybe even hundreds, of thousands of us and join us in sending this tiny clique of bullies a giant "fuck off!"

Because there's safety in numbers, we'll have your back, and there is so many, many more of us than there is of them.
Anonymous AAA dev should know that those SJW are not the ones buying the games, start taking care about your marked and not those don't even use your product.
No, but those SJWs are the ones that are shitting all over the industry and the culture, making it slosh over into mainstream media and then we're getting splattered with shit all over.
